description: Dependency updates under self-host-install: Release pipeline integrity: nothing is proposed before it is 7 days old, and no update to an action pin or an image digest is ever merged without review.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions stay pinned to commit SHAs, and a new pin is never merged without review.
Images (Node, Postgres, Caddy and the CI tools) stay pinned by digest; a new version's tag and digest are bumped weekly, after the 7-day release age, and never merged without review.

No new digest is proposed for the same image tag: it carries no release time, so the 7-day release age could not hold it back. A new version comes with its own tag and digest, and the Tiehall image takes Debian's security updates when it is built (the change image-os-security-updates).
The Node base image: every bump, digest or version, opens its own pull request, labelled for review before merge.
Node stays on the 24 LTS line and Postgres on 17 (design.md, Technical decisions: T1): no major update of them or of the Node types, because a major upgrade is planned work.
TypeScript 7 waits for dependency-cruiser and the Next.js build to support it; open its pull request from the Dependency Dashboard when they do.

customManagers.description: Images that the CI and repository checks run, pinned by digest: gitleaks in the secret scan, Trivy in the image scan and Renovate in pnpm check:renovate.
